definitions.explanation: Describes a person, ability, or work that is average and lacks any outstanding qualities. Carries a negative nuance, implying disappointment at the lack of talent, originality, or distinction.

examples.japanese: {凡庸|ぼんよう}な⟦{作品|さくひん}→作品：02776_sakuhin⟧だった。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{決|けっ}して→決して：01254_kesshite⟧{凡庸|ぼんよう}な⟦{人間|にんげん}→人間：03523_ningen⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: He is by no means an ordinary person.

examples.japanese: {凡庸|ぼんよう}な⟦{指導者|しどうしゃ}→指導者：03062_shidousha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧もと⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{組織|そしき}→組織：03320_soshiki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{成長|せいちょう}→成長：03290_seichou⟧⟦しない→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Under a mediocre leader, an organization won't grow.

notes:
A な-adjective with a distinctly literary and formal tone. Used in writing and formal speech to critique someone or something as lacking distinction. The characters {凡|ぼん} (ordinary) and {庸|よう} (mediocre) both reinforce the sense of unremarkable averageness.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {凡庸|ぼんよう}な⟦{才能|さいのう}→才能：02772_sainou⟧: mediocre talent
- {凡庸|ぼんよう}な⟦{政治家|せいじか}→政治家：03084_seijika⟧: an unremarkable politician
- {凡庸|ぼんよう}さ: mediocrity (noun form)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{平凡|へいぼん}→平凡：12425_heibon⟧: ordinary, common — more neutral, less critical
- ⟦ありきたり→ありきたり：20321_arikitari⟧: commonplace, run-of-the-mill — focuses on lack of originality
- ⟦{陳腐|ちんぷ}→陳腐：09068_chinpu⟧: stale, hackneyed — implies something once novel that has become worn out
- ⟦{非凡|ひぼん}→非凡：15600_hibon⟧: extraordinary — the antonym, using ⟦{非|ひ}→非：28419_hi⟧ (non-) prefix
